why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: Open renaiss.xyz , and reach its X, Discord and other channels only through the link page on its X account, @renaissxyz.
Sign in with email, Google, X or a BNB Chain wallet. If you don't bring a wallet, the site makes one for you.
Link your X and Discord accounts in your profile. Renaiss's own beginner guide advises this, because community activities and badges are tied to them.
Top up USDT on BNB Chain, plus a little BNB for gas. The April guide gave 0.001 BNB for gas and said a first top-up of 60 USDT or more unlocks a badge.

Pull from a pack machine, or buy, bid on or list cards on the marketplace. Warning By the site's own numbers, the $28 pack has an expected value of $31 and a buyback rate of 85%, which works out to $26.35 if you sell straight back. Treat pulls as spending, not as a way to farm.

If you want yield, stake a card in Renaiss Earn. Renaiss warns: "You cannot withdraw a card during the lock-up period, and it may sell before that period ends." It adds: "Earning yield does not guarantee capital protection."
Join the Discord, linked from Renaiss's link page, for Questline and the monthly rankings.
